support_scope: bounded WDI predictive-search replay evidence; grand systems support is allowed only when the preregistered materiality audit, source lock, schema, N, comparators, falsifiers, and tamper checks all pass
model_under_test: World Bank WDI transparent predictive-search family selected per heldout target using only prior same-series rows

comparator_baseline.name: strict best-of carry-forward and prior-mean WDI comparators
comparator_baseline.prediction_rule: support requires the selected model to beat every preregistered comparator on every heldout row

baselines.name: WDI carry-forward last-observation comparator
baselines.prediction_rule: predict target year as the latest prior observed value

baselines.name: WDI prior-training mean comparator
baselines.prediction_rule: predict target year as the arithmetic mean of prior observed values

uncertainty.method: deterministic replay envelope over model residuals

policy.metric: absolute residual advantage over best preregistered comparator

row_gate.uncertainty_upper: row selected-formula prior replay uncertainty interval upper bound

policy.near_tie_policy: a strict comparator residual greater-than is insufficient; grand support requires both aggregate and every row-level best-comparator margin to meet the preregistered materiality thresholds
